patterns: Decade swap goes huge: techhalla 'X-Men but it's 1974 / How to make yours in Magnific' 92K views / 1.5K likes / 346 bookmarks, after One Piece 1977 at 45K the day before. Big pop IP + era restyle + a 'how to make yours' tutorial hook is the format of the week.

MAGI-2 is the tool wave for a 2nd day: maxescu 'Seedance-level quality, 7x cheaper, top 5 things I learned' 11.9K with 258 bookmarks (best save ratio of the day) and 'king of animation' 6K; AIWarper posts 4 MAGI-2 tests (open weights vs hosted 11.6K, side-by-side vs FLUX 3 / Kling 4.0 5.5K).
Learnings listicle + model comparison beat pure demos: numbered tips and same-prompt side-by-sides earn saves, while outsider 'Created with MAGI-2' demos stay under ~1.3K views.
Long-form AI claim: EHuanglu 'people still think AI can only make short clips' 13.6K. Contrarian one-liner + longer video, a softer echo of his 355K/166K streak.
minchoi stays on Claude/Anthropic engineering news (Rust rewrite 14.7K, Karpathy hex-map game 11.8K): off-niche for VFX.

drafts.video_tip: techhalla's 'X-Men but it's 1974' hit 92K with a 'how to make yours' hook. 15s trailer cut: 70s film grain, anamorphic flares, faded Kodachrome palette, title card in a period font. Then a thread: 1 base image, 2 Magnific restyle, 3 animate (Kling/Runway). Pick an IP you are comfortable restyling; fan-art reach depends on it.
